cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your parents' gravy needs stirring and you need a lift to the station. Which am I doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you leave dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It won't stir the gravy. Do I finish their dinner or drive you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finish dinner. I'll book a taxi. Just carry my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose again: suitcase downstairs now, or gravy without lumps for your parents?

mechanism: A copies pausing language from a call into cooking while forcing B to choose which immediate obligation A performs.
confusable: D34 requires two live duties; S04 false confidence should shape the claimed ability to pause one.
comparison: Dinner and departure versus competing pickups.
seedUse: D34-a a helpful taxi solution becomes a new suitcase/gravy priority.
